TOOL RESULT: # The Ralph Wiggum Technique: A Summary

## Core Loop Structure

The Ralph technique operates as a simple Bash loop:
```bash
while :; do cat PROMPT.md | claude-code ; done
```

This monolithic, single-process approach loops continuously, with the LLM performing one discrete task per iteration and deciding autonomously what matters most to implement next.

## Key Principles

**One Task Per Loop (Critical)**
Each iteration must accomplish exactly one thing. This conserves context window—roughly 170k tokens available—preventing quality degradation from excessive allocation. As the creator notes: "The name of the game is that you only have approximately 170k of context window to work with."

**Deterministic Stack Allocation**
Every loop receives the same foundational files:
- `@fix_plan.md` (prioritized todo list)
- `@specs/*` (technical specifications)
- `@AGENT.md` (build/run instructions) …[truncated]
